comment: Hermes' own toolset switches: CONFIGURABLE_TOOLSETS in hermes_cli/tools_config.py, in its order, at the pinned image. talaria-agent-defs' GOVERNED_TOOLSETS is this list minus notGoverned (a cargo test holds the two together), and scripts/chassis-boot-smoke.mjs re-reads the list from the live image and fails when it drifts. When it does: refresh configurable, then either govern the new name or add it to notGoverned with the reason.

notGoverned.stt: Config-only: a provider setting with its own stt.enabled switch, never a model toolset (Hermes' _CONFIG_ONLY_TOOLSETS).
notGoverned.discord: Platform tools for a Discord adapter no Talaria agent runs.
notGoverned.discord_admin: Platform tools for a Discord adapter no Talaria agent runs.
notGoverned.yuanbao: Platform tools for a Yuanbao adapter no Talaria agent runs.
